title: AgentPay Conduit Payment Channels
summary: Let an AI agent pay an API per call with signed off-chain vouchers and settle once on chain.
what: AgentPay Conduit is two Anchor 1.0.2 programs: a registry of paid API providers metered by a gateway, and an escrow of token payment channels settled with ed25519 vouchers verified on chain.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentpay-conduit/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console for the escrow program. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentpay-conduit (fork of Raakshass/agentpay); only declare_id changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentpay-conduit/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet holding lab tokens and call open_channel.
try_steps.see: A channel PDA and a vault holding your deposit.
try_steps.ran: Voucher settlement and timeout refund (see steps).

diagram: owner --register_provider--> provider; gateway --increment_call_count--> provider; agent --open_channel(deposit)--> channel+vault; agent signs voucher(channel_id, cumulative) off chain; gateway --settle(voucher)--> provider paid + agent refund; agent --claim_refund (after timeout)--> refund
innovation: Hundreds of API calls cost one on-chain settlement: the agent signs cumulative vouchers off chain and only the last one is verified on chain with ed25519.
exercises: Why does the voucher sign the cumulative amount rather than each payment?
What stops the gateway from settling an old, smaller voucher?
